tracking_section_subtitle: Monitor the remaining duration of roles you have purchased in real time.
tracking_tip1: Duration is added with each purchase; the countdown advances as a single counter based on the total duration for the same role.
tracking_tip2: If you purchase the same role on different days, the new duration is added to the current end date and updated immediately.
tracking_tip3: Roles shown as "Permanent" have no end date; the countdown does not run.
tracking_tip4: The duration in the top right updates live in months/days/hours/seconds.
tracking_tip5: The "End" date shows the final day of all combined durations.
